title: Harbor Club at Prime

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: They used to say never mix business with pleasure. They were wrong. Here at Harbor Club at Prime we mix business with pleasure regularly, hosting corporate events with world-class cuisine, tranquil views of Huntington Harbor and all the amenities you’ll need to meet your corporate goals. Whether you’re hosting a professional conference or holiday party, corporate training or gala, we will work with you to customize our spaces, menus and beverage programs to suit your specific needs. After all, you work hard enough; let us take the event-planning off your desk.
